meaning.zh:
“时不时” 或 “偶尔”。

这个短语起源于古英语，在现代英语中依然保留，用以描述某件事情不是经常发生，通常为不规则或者偶然的频率。
meaning.en: This phrase originated from Old English and has been retained in modern English. It is used to describe something that happens irregularly or occasionally, rather than frequently.

lines.en: We like to go hiking *from time to time*.
lines.zh: 我们喜欢时不时去徒步。

lines.en: *From time to time*, I think about moving to a new city.
lines.zh: 我时不时会想搬到一个新城市。

lines.en: You should take breaks *from time to time* while working.
lines.zh: 工作时你应该时不时休息一下。
